objects.description: During the [2016 Ukraine Electric Power Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025), [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) used UPX to pack a copy of [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: Dragos Crashoverride 2018)
objects.description_fa: در طول [2016 حمله برق اوکراین](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0025)، [تیم کرم شنی](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) از UPX برای بسته‌بندی یک کپی از [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002] استفاده کرد.[[ERVE_0]] (Citation: Dragos Crashoverride 2018)
